newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-PACKERS RE-SIGN WIDE RECEIVER BEEBE.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-PACKERS RE-SIGN WIDE RECEIVER BEEBE.

text.p: The Super Bowl champion Green Bay Packers held on to wide receiver Don Beebe, re-signing the valuable contributor on Wednesday.

Beebe, an unrestricted free agent, caught 39 passes for 699 yards and four touchdowns last season and filled in admirably as a starter for six mid-season games when injuries to Robert Brooks and Antonio Freeman depleted the club's receiving corps.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The 32-year-old Beebe will enter his second year with Green Bay after six seasons with the Buffalo Bills and one with the Carolina Panthers. He has 217 career receptions for 3,388 yards and 23 touchdowns. In 14 career post-season games, Beebe has 35 catches for 466 yards and three touchdowns.

Beebe is the third of the 11 unrestricted free agents to re-sign with the Packers, joining defensive tackle Gilbert Brown and quarterback Doug Pederson. Receiver/kick returner Desmond Howard, the MVP of the Super Bowl, signed with the Oakland Raiders.
The Packers also signed offensive tackle Marcus Spears, a free agent who has spent the last three years with the Chicago Bears. He was a second-round draft choice of the Bears in 1994.
